sbar.situation: The bank payment system has recovered after two separate faults. One recovery check at 20 s ran the main payment journey cleanly, with all component metrics clean.
sbar.background: The gateway process went down with no recent change and no log output, so every payment journey timed out at the gateway after 3.0 s. Separately, the clearing worker crashed with exit code 1 on malformed queue item 95 (JSONDecodeError in clear_one at 'message = self.parse(item)'), and its backlog grew.
sbar.assessment: Root causes were the gateway process being down (confidence 0.85) and a poison message on clearing (confidence 0.8). The incident commander set aside clearing item 95 for the operations team, then restarted clearing and restarted the gateway itself; all three actions completed.
sbar.recommendation: Watch the gateway and the clearing backlog, since recovery rests on a single clean look. The operations team has been asked (soon) to review item 95 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer, because that payment has not cleared.
